record.field: Standard steps to bring a newly signed client on board, from account creation to the first invoice.
Create the customer record with billing address, VAT number and main contact.
Use the welcome email template and attach the onboarding guide.
Share the folder with the client contacts only, with edit rights.
Final checks to run before a new website goes live for a customer.
Check spelling, broken links and placeholder images on every page.
Test on Chrome, Firefox, Safari and one mobile device.
Steps to complete when an employee leaves the company.
Disable email, VPN and all application accounts on the last working day.
